products.name: Adobe Campaign
products.title: Adobe Campaign v8 (Managed Cloud Services)
products.what: Adobe's cross-channel campaign management product: email, SMS, push, direct mail and transactional messages sent from its own customer database, with workflows that build audiences and move data. These lines are written for Campaign v8, which Adobe runs as a Managed Cloud Service with a console application and a Web user interface.

source.title: Experience League: Get started with Campaign v8

products.notes: One box, written for Campaign v8. Adobe's pages support v8 as the version to write for: the Campaign Classic FAQ calls v8 Adobe's strategic platform, and the Campaign Web pages say Campaign Standard users may move to v8. Adobe's own statements on Campaign Classic v7 and Campaign Standard are quoted in the trail, not on any card. CG07 is the one line for a client still on an earlier version. Campaign v8 is a managed service: Adobe sets the environment, installs add-ons and switches on each connection to another Adobe product, so partner work is the configuration and build around what Adobe provisions. Administration sits in the console application; the Web user interface is for marketers. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: An Adobe Campaign v8 Managed Cloud Services license; Adobe sets the environment and its first configuration
Add-ons and capabilities that were not provisioned, requested through your client's Adobe Transition Manager
Users who sign in with an Adobe ID, added in the Admin Console to product profiles that match Campaign operator groups
Connections to other Adobe products switched on by Adobe on request
For transactional messages: Transactional messaging configured in the environment by Adobe
For the Web user interface: the minimum Campaign release Adobe names on its FAQ page, with sign-in through Adobe's identity system

prereq_sources.quote: With Campaign Managed Cloud Services, your environment and initial configuration is set by Adobe, according to the terms of your license agreement.
If you need to use a Campaign add-on or a specific capability which has not been provisioned for you, you must contact your Adobe Transition Manager.
Permissions are granted through Adobe Admin Console and Campaign Client Console.
As a Managed Cloud Services user, contact Adobe to connect Campaign with Adobe Experience Cloud services and solutions.
As a Managed Cloud Services user, contact Adobe to configure Campaign Transactional messaging in your environment.
To access the new user interface, Adobe Campaign version 8.6 is required, and Adobe Identity Management System (IMS) is mandatory.

products.name: Adobe Advertising
products.title: Adobe Advertising (DSP; Search, Social, & Commerce; Creative)
products.what: Adobe's ad buying suite, in three parts: Advertising DSP for display, video, connected TV, audio and native ads; Search, Social, & Commerce for search, shopping, social and performance max campaigns across ad networks; and Advertising Creative for personalized ad experiences.

source.title: Experience League: About Adobe Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce

products.notes: One box for the three parts; each line carries a tag for the part it needs. Adobe's own teams do much of the setup: Adobe or an affiliate agency launches Search, Social, & Commerce with each advertiser, and Adobe's account and implementation teams switch on the integrations with Analytics, Audience Manager, Real-Time CDP and Experience Manager. Partner lines are the planning, tagging, structure, audiences, reporting and running of campaigns around that. The word Commerce in Search, Social, & Commerce means commerce ad campaigns; Adobe documents no connection to the Adobe Commerce product. ChatGPT conversational ads and the AI Assistant's agent features carry a label that Adam's rule excludes (see left_out), and the Search, Social, & Commerce guide files its new user interface under a labelled heading, so AV05 rests on the implementation overview page outside it. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: An Adobe Advertising account for each part in scope, launched with Adobe or one of its affiliate agencies
Enough account credit in DSP to run the whole campaign
An administrator who invites the team, because new DSP users start with read-only access
For Search, Social, & Commerce: access credentials and tracking options for each ad network account to sync
Conversion tracking tags on your client's site, or a daily feed of conversion data
For Search, Social, & Commerce optimization: at least 14 days of click and revenue data before a portfolio launches

prereq_sources.quote: Adobe or one of its affiliate agencies works with each advertiser to launch its online advertising portfolios and to track any additional ad campaigns.
Make sure your account has enough credit to run the entire campaign.
New users have read-only access by default.

Synchronize with the account by a) creating a corresponding account record in Search, Social, & Commerce that contains the account access credentials and tracking options and b) setting the account status to enabled.

Depending on the implementation, this may involve adding conversion tracking tags to the appropriate webpages and/or setting up a daily feed drop for conversion data that you've collected using your own method.
The implementation team then gathers and validates click and revenue data for at least 14 days and validates the portfolio settings.

lines.scope: Create custom DSP segments with their tracking tags for site visitors and ad exposure, combine first-party and third-party segments into reusable audiences, and attach them to placements as targets or exclusions.

source.title: Experience League: About audience management in Advertising DSP

lines.scope: Set up your client's private deals with publishers by deal ID, attach them to placements and ads, and check delivery and pricing against what was negotiated.

source.title: Experience League: About private inventory

lines.name: Search, Social, & Commerce accounts, tracking and portfolios
lines.scope: Sync your client's ad network accounts, set up click and conversion tracking, agree the objectives and metrics, and build the portfolios that group campaigns for bid and budget optimization, with the baseline period before each portfolio launches.
lines.evidence: Set up portfolios configured to meet your objective and business goals, with the appropriate campaigns.

source.title: Experience League: Overview of implementing Search, Social, & Commerce

lines.scope: Build your client's creative libraries and bundles, set up ad experiences with decision tree targeting by audience and location, and export the ad tags to Advertising DSP or another buying platform.
lines.evidence: Experiences with decision tree targeting: Creative allows you to configure personalized ad experiences throughout the customer journey using a decision tree model.

source.title: Experience League: About experiences in Advertising Creative

products.name: Marketo Measure
products.title: Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible)
products.what: Adobe's B2B marketing attribution product: it tracks web sessions and ad spend, ties touchpoints to leads, contacts and opportunities in the CRM, and reports which channels drive pipeline and revenue. These lines are written for the tiers that connect directly to a CRM and to Marketo Engage; Marketo Measure Ultimate takes its data through Experience Platform and is written up as the Real-Time CDP connection.

source.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure Ultimate overview

products.notes: Two editions that are set up differently. Tiers 1 to 3 connect straight to Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics and to Marketo Engage, and can write touchpoints back to the CRM; MZ01 to MZ08 are written for them. Marketo Measure Ultimate has no direct CRM or Marketo Engage connection, takes B2B data through Experience Platform, writes nothing back to the CRM, and has no migration path from the tiers, so it is the mmeasure-rtcdp connection. Adobe's current release notes page covers 2024 releases only; that is raised for Adam in the trail and stated on no card. Cross-domain tracking and view-through attribution are deprecated and no line rests on them. The CRM and the ad platforms are outside systems the tool already draws (crm, ads); MZ02 and MZ04 carry that work on the product. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: A Marketo Measure subscription, with the Adobe Admin Console provisioned for its users
Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics as the CRM, with the Marketo Measure package installed or a dedicated connected user for the packageless route
The Marketo Measure JavaScript on every tracked page, and every domain claimed in the Admin Console
A decision on sandbox or production before Salesforce is connected, because a production connection cannot be moved back to a sandbox
Spend data for every channel: connected ad accounts, CRM campaign costs or uploads
For Marketo Measure Ultimate: B2B data brought in through Experience Platform, because the direct CRM and Marketo Engage connections do not exist there

prereq_sources.quote: The first step to using Marketo Measure is to create and sign in to your provisioned Adobe Admin Console.
Through the standard Marketo Measure installation, you are required to install a Salesforce Package or a Microsoft Dynamics Managed Solution.
Make sure you've claimed all appropriate domains in the Adobe Admin Console in addition to deploying the Marketo Measure JavaScript.
Once your Marketo Measure account is connected to a Salesforce production instance, you cannot move backwards and connect to a sandbox.
To have accurate and comprehensive ROI reporting across all of your channels and subchannels, you must make sure you have the appropriate spend data being pulled into Marketo Measure.
The direct CRM and Marketo Engage connections are no longer available for Ultimate.

tiers.what: The editions these lines assume: a direct connection to Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics and to Marketo Engage. Which attribution models a subscription includes depends on the tier.
tiers.quote: This article outlines the migration process for users moving from the Tier 1 or 2 subscription to Marketo Measure Ultimate.

tiers.what: The edition that takes B2B data from nearly any source through Experience Platform. It is a new implementation, set up through the Real-Time CDP connection (XM30, XM31).

lines.name: Admin Console users and tracking script rollout
lines.scope: Add your client's admins and users in the Adobe Admin Console, claim each domain, and deploy the Marketo Measure JavaScript on every page and form of every tracked site, hardcoded or through a tag manager. Test that sessions and form fills are captured.
lines.evidence: Having the Marketo Measure JavaScript deployed correctly and comprehensively across your entire site(s) will ensure that the session data collected produces accurate touchpoint data.

source.title: Experience League: Best practices for implementing Marketo Measure JavaScript

lines.name: CRM package and connection
lines.scope: Install the Marketo Measure package in your client's Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics sandbox and then in production, or set up the packageless route with a dedicated connected user. Connect the CRM, and set permission sets and page layouts.
lines.evidence: Through the standard Marketo Measure installation, you are required to install a Salesforce Package or a Microsoft Dynamics Managed Solution.

source.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure CRM packageless integration

lines.name: Online and offline channel mapping
lines.scope: Agree your client's UTM conventions, write the online channel rules and the offline channel mapping to CRM campaign types, set the campaign sync rules that turn campaign members into touchpoints, and check touchpoints land in the right channel and subchannel.
lines.evidence: To have accurate reporting, marketing channels must be set up to reflect your organization's UTM strategy.

source.title: Experience League: Online custom channel setup

lines.name: Ad platform connections and spend data
lines.scope: Connect your client's ad accounts with the right roles, set up tagging on ad URLs, switch on CRM campaign costs where used, and load spend for the channels that have no connection.
lines.evidence: Any Ad Account that you have connected to Marketo Measure through an API has its spend automatically pulled into Marketo Measure for ROI reporting.

source.title: Experience League: Spend management methods

lines.name: Stage mapping and attribution model setup
lines.scope: Order your client's lead, contact and opportunity stages in Stage Mapping, choose the stages and weights for the custom attribution model where the subscription includes it, and review touchpoint and segment settings with marketing and sales operations.
lines.evidence: The validity of your Marketo Measure data relies on these stages being ordered correctly so that Marketo Measure can accurately understand your funnel and the progression of records throughout said funnel.

source.title: Experience League: Best practices for stage mapping

lines.name: Discover dashboards for marketing and sales
lines.scope: Walk your client's teams through the Discover dashboards, agree the filters and segments each group reads, and set the short list of revenue, pipeline and return views that leadership sees each month.
lines.evidence: Every dashboard has a range of filters, accompanied by the following controls for seamless navigation and customization.

source.title: Experience League: Discover dashboard basics

lines.name: Data warehouse access and BI report template
lines.scope: Give your client's analysts access to the data warehouse reader account, connect Adobe's Power BI or Tableau report template, and adapt it to your client's channels and date ranges.
lines.evidence: This is a read-only account that's available for your organization, not just an individual user.

source.title: Experience League: Data warehouse access, reader account

lines.name: Monthly attribution upkeep
lines.scope: Each month, enable touchpoints for new CRM campaigns, load new spend, review channel mapping against new UTM values and domains, and report attributed pipeline and revenue by channel.
lines.evidence: Marketo Measure pulls almost everything that it needs from your CRM on a daily basis, but there are a few maintenance tasks you should schedule regularly to keep Marketo Measure humming along and outputting the most accurate information possible.

source.title: Experience League: Marketo Measure maintenance
